title: Make graceful session close atomic
description: Review finding from loreweaver-niw. closeSessionGracefully can write recaps for unknown sessions and can leave partial close state if later rollups fail after closing scenes or writing summaries. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: closeSessionGracefully validates the target session before rollups; unknown sessions leave no recap or summary rows; injected rollup failures leave session, scene, recap, and summaries unchanged; checkpoint remains outside the DB transaction.
close_reason: Made graceful session close validate the target session before rollups and wrap scene close, summaries, recap, arc rollup, and session close in one DB transaction while keeping checkpoint outside. Verification: git diff --check, npm run typecheck, and npm run test passed; TDD evidence recorded.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Debug evidence: closeSessionGracefully currently reads wasClosed, closes open scene and summary in one transaction, then writes session recap, optional arc rollup, and closeSession in separate calls. Root cause: the target session is not validated before rollups, and DB mutations are not wrapped in one transaction before checkpoint.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD RED: npm run test -- packages/core/test/sessionClose.test.ts -> failed as expected. Unknown close wrote a session_recap for missing session. Injected arc rollup JSON serialization failure left the open scene closed (getOpenScene undefined) instead of rolling back all close mutations.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD GREEN: npm run test -- packages/core/test/sessionClose.test.ts -> passed; 1 file, 4 tests. closeSessionGracefully now validates the session before rollups and wraps scene close, summaries, recap, arc rollup, and session close in one DB transaction; checkpoint remains after transaction.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Verification: git diff --check -> exit 0. npm run typecheck -> exit 0. npm run test -> exit 0; 35 test files passed, 199 tests passed, 1 skipped. TDD evidence: RED sessionClose tests failed for unknown-session recap write and partial scene-close state; GREEN focused tests passed after making close DB mutations transactional.
